rules.condition: is a visible enemy within melee range of this bot?
rules.criteria_true: an enemy is inside the bot's melee reach
rules.criteria_false: no enemy is inside the bot's melee reach

rules.condition: is a visible enemy within attack range but not melee range of this bot?
rules.criteria_true: an enemy is in attack range but outside melee range
rules.criteria_false: no enemy is in attack range but outside melee range

rules.condition: is the primary ability 'chord' off cooldown?
rules.criteria_true: the ability is ready to use

rules.condition: is this bot's current health below a quarter of its maximum health?
rules.criteria_true: health is less than 25% of max
rules.criteria_false: health is 25% or more of max

rules.condition: are there no enemies within attack range of this bot?
rules.criteria_true: no enemies are in attack range
rules.criteria_false: at least one enemy is in attack range
